## Key Resources

- [Portfolio Home](https://chetan-bhosale.vercel.app/): Main portfolio detailing experience at Linkrunner and Petpooja, personal projects (DoviaAI, TrafficMine, GenChat), education, and contact details.

## Projects

- [DoviaAI](https://dovia-delta.vercel.app/): A no-code/low-code platform that lets you build apps and UI components instantly using prompts.
- [TrafficMine](https://github.com/ChetanBhosale/TrafficMine): Website performance and user behavior tracking tool.
- [GenChat](https://github.com/ChetanBhosale/GenChat): Custom AI-powered chatbots builder for websites.
